title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 Review: The Littlest Smartphone That Could

claims.claim: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8, selefine kıyasla 100 dolar daha pahalıdır.

evidence.quote: Like almost every other phone this year, the Z Flip8 offers tiny improvements over its predecessor and costs $100 more.

claims.claim: Z Flip8, selefine göre 0.02 inç daha ince ve bir gramın üçte biri kadar daha hafiftir.

evidence.quote: The Flip8 has an IP48 rating
The Flip8 has an IP48 rating, so you don’t need to worry about dropping it in the bath, but tiny dust and dirt particles (less than 1 millimeter) can still cause damage.

claims.claim: Cihazın dış kısmında 4.1 inç AMOLED ekran, iç kısmında ise 6.9 inç AMOLED ana ekran bulunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: It has a sharp 4.1-inch AMOLED display on the outside with a 60- or 120-Hz refresh rate. Open it up to reveal the 6.9-inch main display, also AMOLED

It has a sharp 4.1-inch AMOLED display on the outside with a 60- or 120-Hz refresh rate. Open it up to reveal the 6.9-inch main display, also AMOLED but with a variable refresh rate (1 to 120 Hz) that’s better for battery life.

claims.claim: Z Flip8, Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 işlemciye, 12 GB RAM'e ve 256 GB depolama alanına sahiptir.

evidence.quote: the Z Flip8 boasts the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy (the same cutting-edge chip that's in its two bigger siblings). It has 12 GB of RAM and 256 GB of storage.
but the Z Flip8 boasts the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy (the same cutting-edge chip that's in its two bigger siblings). It has 12 GB of RAM and 256 GB of storage.

claims.claim: Telefon, 25 watt kablolu ve 15 watt kablosiz şarj hızlarını destekler.

evidence.quote: Charging speeds are disappointing at 25 watts wired and 15 watts wireless
Charging speeds are disappointing at 25 watts wired and 15 watts wireless, and I’m annoyed by Samsung’s refusal to implement the magnetic feature of Qi2.

claims.claim: Z Flip8, 50 megapiksel ana kameraya ve 12 megapiksel ultra geniş kameraya sahiptir.

evidence.quote: That said, the main 50-megapixel shooter is perfectly good in many situations, and most folks will be happy with the photos it captures. Some noise creeps in when it’s dark. The 12-megapixel ultrawide is useful when you want to cram a lot in or take a group selfie

That said, the main 50-megapixel shooter is perfectly good in many situations, and most folks will be happy with the photos it captures. Some noise creeps in when it’s dark. The 12-megapixel ultrawide is useful when you want to cram a lot in or take a group selfie, but it’s a definite step down in quality.

claims.claim: Samsung, Z Flip8 için yedi yıllık platform ve güvenlik yazılımı güncellemesi sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: If you do pull the trigger on the Flip8, you get an excellent seven years of platform and security software updates
If you do pull the trigger on the Flip8, you get an excellent seven years of platform and security software updates, potentially taking you all the way to 2033.
